cases.error: OP_FRAME_ENGINE_INSTANCE='fe 0': letters, digits and dashes only
OP_FRAME_ENGINE_INSTANCE='-': letters, digits and dashes only

differences.OP_FRAME_ENGINE_LANES: the default is the physical cores, lowered to what fits in the card (plan 17 section 2.1 and N2); a value that is set means the same and has the same range
differences.OP_FRAME_ENGINE_SWITCH_INTERVAL_MS: tunes Python's interpreter lock; the native engine has none, so a start with it set is refused (plan 17 section 1.1)

native_only.OP_FRAME_ENGINE_EXPECT_BUS_ID: refuse the start on any card but this PCI bus id (a host run names its card by it)
